What I’ve Learned

Working as a software engineer has taught me a lot — not just about code, but about systems, teams, and tradeoffs.

Some of the most valuable lessons I’ve picked up:

  • Read the error message. Seriously, most answers are right there.
  • Boring technology is underrated. Proven tools exist for a reason.
  • Write it down. If it’s worth building, it’s worth documenting.

My Projects Here are some of the projects I’ve been working on. You can find more on my GitHub.
Textile Production Planning System A microservices-based system to help textile manufacturers plan and control factory production.
Tech: Node.js, MongoDB, React.js
Outsourced Manufacturer Audit App An application to audit and manage outsourced manufacturers for quality control.
Tech: Node.js, MongoDB, React.js
Hotel Proposal Generation System A system supporting a hotel’s sales team in generating and sending priced proposal orders to clients.
Tech: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Oracle, React.js
AI-Driven WhatsApp Sales Engine An AI-driven sales engine with a WhatsApp interface for selling financial products.
Tech: Node.js
E-commerce Platform New features and ongoing maintenance for an e-commerce platform.
Tech: Laravel, MySQL, JavaScript, Bootstrap
More projects coming soon.
